page_title: SOU 2-3 LIV | Southampton v Liverpool 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Jack Stephens (Southampton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+7' A player from Southampton pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.

90+5' What a chance that is! Jack Stephens (Southampton) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
90+4' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) brings an opponent down and Samuel Barrott interrupts the game. Southampton are awarded the free kick.
90+1' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+1' Liverpool are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) replaces Darwin Nunez.
88' OFF THE POST! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
84' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
83' 2 - 3 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Alex McCarthy.
82' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty for Liverpool!
80' Liverpool are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
77' Here is a change. Ryan Fraser is going off and Russell Martin gives the last tactical orders to Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton).
77' Substitution. Adam Armstrong makes way for Cameron Archer (Southampton).
76' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.
76' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
76' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
73' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
72' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is hurriedly cleared.
72' The Liverpool players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
69' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
68' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
67' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

67' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' 2 - 2 GOAL! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) scores easily from mid range after being presented with the ball on a golden platter after the goalkeeper slips. It’s 2:2.
63' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Luis Diaz.
62' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luis Diaz (Liverpool) replacing Cody Gakpo.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) for Curtis Jones.
61' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
59' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Alex McCarthy comes off his line to gather the ball.

56' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom left corner. The assist goes to Adam Armstrong and the score changes to 2:1.
56' Liverpool fail to score from a corner as Alex McCarthy (Southampton) leaps to collect the ball.
56' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

54' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Samuel Barrott blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick to Liverpool.

53' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) showcases his fine individual ability by beating a couple of players and hits a good long-range shot. The keeper has to scramble but the ball flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
52' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is being substituted because of an injury. Russell Martin sends Lesley Ugochukwu on the pitch.
50' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
49' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
48' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Liverpool win a corner.
46' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:11.

45+3' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
42' 1 - 1 Goal! Adam Armstrong (Southampton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
42' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) misses the penalty! He fired the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulled off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
42' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
42' Referee Samuel Barrott is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Southampton!
41' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Southampton as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
41' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
39' A pass into the penalty area from Joe Aribo (Southampton) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
37' Problems for Russell Martin as Adam Lallana is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Joe Aribo (Southampton) replaces him.
36' Adam Lallana (Southampton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Flynn Downes (Southampton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton.

33' Flynn Downes (Southampton) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Southampton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
33' The corner is swung in but Southampton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

33' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is out of play and Southampton manage to earn a corner.
30' 0 - 1 GOAL! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.

28' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
27' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

27' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Alex McCarthy has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
25' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
23' Adam Lallana (Southampton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

21' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Alex McCarthy, who pulls off a stunning save!
19' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
16' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
16' Half-chance! Conor Bradley (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Alex McCarthy reacts well to snuff out the attack.
13' The referee is firm and issues Conor Bradley (Liverpool) a deserved yellow card.
12' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
8' A cross from a corner kick by Southampton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
7' The ball is cleared after Adam Armstrong (Southampton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Now Southampton have a corner.
6' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Alex McCarthy (Southampton).

6' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alex McCarthy pulls off a brilliant save. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
5' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
4' An attempted cross from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared.
3' One of the Southampton players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
Liverpool will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Samuel Barrott.
